'''Adriana Albini''' (born 1955) is an Italian pathologist and cancer researcher. She developed the concept of [[angioprevention]] which can be used to control cancer development. She is a competitive fencer and six of her novels have been published. In 2000 she was the Scientific Director at the Fondazione MultiMedica Onlus in Milan.

== Life ==
Albini was born in [[Venice]], Italy, on 2 September 1955.<ref name=fence>{{Cite web|title=INTERNATIONAL FENCING FEDERATION – The International Fencing Federation official website|url=http://fie.org/athletes/29583|access-date=27 November 2020|website=FIE.org}}</ref>

In 1985 she had her doctorate and she was employed in research at the Max-Planck Institute for Biochemistry.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Adriana Albini|url=https://eutranslationalmedicine.org/adriana-albini|access-date=27 November 2020|website=European Society for the Translational Medicine (EUSTM)|language=en-US|archive-date=12 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210112050405/https://eutranslationalmedicine.org/adriana-albini|url-status=dead}}</ref>

She works in Milan at the Fondazione MultiMedica Onlus where she is the Scientific Director. She has developed the concept of [[Angioprevention]].<ref name=":1" /> [[Angiogenesis]] is the name given to the process of forming [[blood vessel]]s and therefore preventing this process from operating could be used to prevent disease development .<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Bisacchi|first1=D|last2=Benelli|first2=R|last3=Vanzetto|first3=C|last4=Ferrari|first4=N|last5=Tosetti|first5=F|last6=Albini|first6=A|date=1 January 2003|title=Anti-angiogenesis and angioprevention: mechanisms, problems and perspectives|url=http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0361090X03000308|journal=Cancer Detection and Prevention|language=en|volume=27|issue=3|pages=229–238|doi=10.1016/S0361-090X(03)00030-8|pmid=12787731|issn=0361-090X|url-access=subscription}}</ref> Albini and others have shown that several drugs and natural compounds for [[cancer]] chemo-prevention (or [[chemoprophylaxis]])  actually prevent tumor [[blood vessel]] formation.<ref>Tosetti F, Ferrari N, De Flora S, Albini A. Angioprevention': angiogenesis is a common and key target for cancer  chemopreventive agents.FASEB J. 2002 Jan;16(1):2–14.</ref> Her concept has been furthered through the identification of many other "angiopreventive" compounds.<ref name=":1">Albini A, Indraccolo S, Noonan DM, Pfeffer U. Functional genomics of endothelial cells treated with anti-angiogenic or angiopreventive drugs.Clin Exp Metastasis. 2010 Aug;27(6):419-39</ref>

Albini was the first Italian to serve on the council of the [[American Association for Cancer Research]].<ref name=bbc/> In 2014 the Provincial Council of [[Brescia]] awarded her the <nowiki>''Donne Che Ce L’hanno Fatta''</nowiki> (Women Who Made It) award. The following year she was given a Special Recognition Award by the European Union Women Inventors and Innovators Network International (EUWIIN). In 2020 Albini was identified as one of the [[100 Women (BBC)|BBC's 100 Women]].<ref name=bbc>{{Cite news|date=23 November 2020|title=BBC 100 Women 2020: Who is on the list this year?|language=en-GB|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-55042935|access-date=27 November 2020}}</ref>

== Other interests ==
Albini has written six novels under a [[pen name]]. She is also a competitive fencer<ref name=fence/> and in May 2015 she won the silver medal at the 2015 European Veteran Fencing championship in her age class behind Marja-Liisa Someroja of Finland.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Results|url=http://www.european-veterans-fencing.com/results.html|access-date=27 November 2020|website=www.european-veterans-fencing.com|archive-date=23 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201123192005/http://www.european-veterans-fencing.com/results.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
